[curious, lively, starts speaking immediately] Jump into a hole straight through the Earth. You would fall for thirty-eight minutes, and then something strange happens. Gravity pulls you toward the center, faster and faster. By the center, you are moving several miles every second. But past the center, gravity flips. Now it pulls you backward, slowing you down the whole long way up. You rise out the other side of the planet, stop exactly at the surface, and hang there for a heartbeat. Then gravity pulls you back in. With no air to slow you down, you would ride it back and forth forever.
